If set to `false`, will prevent rendering to a path that already exists. Default is `true`.

## CLI flag

```text
--overwrite
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#overwrite)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#overwrite)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#overwrite)
